author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Conley linked to Heat
desc: Mike Conley is expected to be a priority target in free agency for Miami.
impact: The Heat will be looking to build around Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo. They'll likely be focusing on adding more shooting in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tim Hardaway Jr. linked to Heat
desc: Tim Hardaway Jr. is expected to be a priority target in free agency for Miami.
impact: The Heat will be looking to build around Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo. They'll likely be focusing on adding more shooting in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tari Eason expected to have qualifying offer extended by Rockets
desc: The Rockets are reportedly likely to extend a qualifying offer to Tari Eason.
impact: The move would make Eason a restricted free agent this offseason.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Norman Powell linked to Pistons
desc: The Pistons have reportedly shown interest in Norman Powell.
impact: Powell returning to Miami became more unlikely after the Heat traded for Giannis Antetokounmpo. Detroit continues to look to add more shooting around Cade Cunningham.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cameron Johnson drawing trade interest from several teams
desc: Cameron Johnson has reportedly drawn trade interest from several teams.
impact: The Nuggets could be looking to make roster changes this offseason. The Lakers, Celtics, Heat, Clippers, and Magic have been linked to Denver.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jaylen Brown drawing trade interest from various teams
desc: Jaylen Brown has reportedly drawn trade interest from various teams.
impact: While the trade talks with Boston fell through, it still appears that Brown is likely to be on the move this offseason. The Trail Blazers, Raptors, Nuggets, Nets, Hornets, Hawks, and Clippers are among the teams who have been mentioned.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Royce O'Neale traded to Hornets
desc: The Suns are trading Grayson Allen, Royce O'Neale and a 2033 first-round pick to the Hornets for Miles Bridges, a 2029 first-round pick and a 2027 second-round pick.
impact: O'Neale and Allen both join a Hornets team that just traded LaMelo Ball and now move on from Bridges. They'll figure to both slide into reserve roles behind Kon Knueppel and Brandon Miller. The Hornets continue to shake up their roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grayson Allen traded to Hornets
desc: The Suns are trading Grayson Allen, Royce O'Neale and a 2033 first-round pick to the Hornets for Miles Bridges, a 2029 first-round pick and a 2027 second-round pick.
impact: Allen and O'Neale both join a Hornets team that just traded LaMelo Ball and now move on from Bridges. They'll figure to both slide into reserve roles behind Kon Knueppel and Brandon Miller. The Hornets continue to shake up their roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Bridges traded to Suns
desc: The Charlotte Hornets are trading Miles Bridges, a 2029 first-round pick and a 2027 second-round pick to the Phoenix Suns for Grayson Allen, Royce O'Neale and a 2033 first-round pick.
impact: The Hornets continue to make moves after already trading LaMelo Ball. Bridges should slide right into a starting spot at forward for Phoenix.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyrese Haliburton (Achilles) says he can 'do everything'
desc: Tyrese Haliburton told reporters that he is "able to do everything."
impact: Haliburton did not play at all last season. It appeared he had a chance to return late in the year until he had a case of shingles in February. He appears well on his way to be back to being to full strength for the start of next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alijah Martin tendered by Raptors
desc: The Raptors tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Alijah Martin.
impact: Martin is set to become a restricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Buddy Hield pushes back guaranteed deadline date on contract
desc: The Hawks and Buddy Hield have agreed to push back the guaranteed deadline date on his contract.
impact: The move allows both sides to have more time to flush out options. The original deadline date was last Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bogdan Bogdanovic pushes option date back to June 29 with Clippers
desc: The Clippers and Bogdan Bogdanović have agreed to push back his option date to June 29.
impact: Los Angeles is continuing trade conversations for Bogdanović.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yaxel Lendeborg (ankle/knee) expected to play in Summer League
desc: Yaxel Lendeborg said he does plan to play in summer league.
impact: Lendeborg suffered an ankle sprain and left knee bone bruise in Michigan's title run. He clarified that he is now fully healthy.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tamar Bates signs two-way deal with Jazz
desc: The Utah Jazz plan to sign Tamar Bates to a two-way deal.
impact: Bates was sidelined with a foot injury as a two-way rookie for the Nuggets last season.
